question: What structured division of eight octads is sought to be fully known without limit?
premises: A division consisting of eight octads is named
The speaker seeks to know it fully
The knowing is described as endless or complete
inference: The speaker seeks to fully know the division of the eight octads in its entirety
uncertainties: anantathā may indicate endless extent or an infinite manner
plain_english: And I seek to fully know, without end, the division of the eight octads.
